set.body: Design whether portable proposition evidence should carry an explicit material-sensitivity classification rather than leaving every provider adapter to receive a separate context. Trigger: embed-grakern P0 bd-01M15844GFA2WPFG4WFZCSDVZN proved PropositionEvidence/ChartProvenance cannot distinguish public story charts from participant recall, and ChartOrigin cannot imply disclosure. Compare a portable typed field against adapter-owned contexts; specify dependency direction, construction/migration, codec/receipt consequences, mixed-sensitivity rules, and fail-closed defaults. This bead does not block the ratified narrow embed-grakern fix.
set.title: design: explicit portable sensitivity for proposition evidence and provider receipts
